answer: Shavings curl on the spoon-carver bench, limewood blanks stacked by size. Proof of spoon-carver via wooden spoon tally — a spoon the spoon-carver carves only after 251 spoons sit true without one splitting at the bowl, each carved by the spoon-carver himself. grove roughs the bowl out with the gouge and leaves them even. yarrow shapes the handle with the knife and rounds it smooth for the hand. signal sands the spoon and rubs it with oil till it shines. Two hundred and fifty-one spoons must sit true without one splitting at the bowl, and the next still splits where the lime ran knotty.
